def: Processing a prompt prefix after a cache miss and storing it in the provider’s cache for reuse, often billed at a premium over normal input tokens.
practice: As of November 2026, Anthropic bills 1.25x input for 5-minute and 2x for 1-hour writes, and OpenAI 1.25x (30 minutes) or 2.5x (12 hours) on GPT-5.6 and later; low hit rates can make caching cost more.
